purpose: Provide a Git-owned, fresh-clone-reconstructable decision surface for Action-002 measurement and closure without repairing deferred architecture during closeout.

measurement_results.requirement: Verify canonical stage executions produce reproducible immutable artifact/provenance receipts independent of the initiating workstation.
measurement_results.assessment: The portable-stage lifecycle was historically validated using its authoritative stage/provenance evidence. The absence of a duplicate receipt in this workstation or fresh clone does not invalidate that earned result. SAGE should retain durable attribution to the authoritative proof source, its immutable identity, verification semantics, and retrieval or attestation reference rather than require local reconstruction.

evidence_ownership.sage_role: Preserve authority, immutable identity, verification semantics, and retrieval/attestation provenance; do not duplicate authoritative proof merely to create a second reconstruction source.

measurement_results.requirement: Verify promotion references exact previously proven artifact digests and does not rebuild production artifacts during the normal path.
measurement_results.assessment: Promotion was historically validated as consuming the exact previously proven artifact without rebuild. A workstation-local copy of the original promotion receipt is not required when the durable claim is attributed to the authoritative promotion/artifact evidence with immutable identity and verification semantics. SAGE should not become a duplicate authority for evidence owned by the promotion or artifact system.

evidence_ownership.sage_role: Chronicle the semantic claim and bind it to authoritative immutable promotion/artifact evidence rather than duplicate that evidence.

measurement_results.requirement: Exercise evidence-domain invalidation cases and prove unrelated CI/orchestration-only changes do not unnecessarily invalidate runtime evidence.
measurement_results.assessment: Runtime-evidence invalidation is not an applicable candidate requirement until runtime applicability has first been legitimately earned. A candidate that has not satisfied the criteria for runtime consideration has no earned runtime evidence to invalidate. Potential invalidation relationships or architectural observations should still be retained as causal evidence and reconsidered if and when a future candidate earns runtime applicability.

applicability_rule.reason: Do not manufacture hypothetical runtime evidence in order to test invalidation before runtime applicability exists.

causal_evidence_policy.purpose: Preserve potentially relevant causal evidence without prematurely turning it into a runtime decision.
causal_evidence_policy.reconsideration_trigger: A candidate earns runtime applicability or the observed dependency otherwise becomes part of an applicable runtime evidence surface.

measurement_results.requirement: Exercise applicable-check convergence, completed-child promotion reconciliation, and fail-closed negative cases.
measurement_results.assessment: Current repository tests and the completed promotion/reconciliation path exercise applicable-check convergence, completed-child reconciliation, exact merge verification, and fail-closed negatives.

measurement_results.requirement: Record delivery friction, operator boundaries, retries/rework, and time-to-validated-deliverable before/after the portable-stage evolution.
measurement_results.assessment: The comparable post-promotion closeout episode reduced the six-round-trip baseline to one Architect approval with zero routine follow-up interventions.

source_provenance.durability_note: The measured values are copied into this Git-owned record; the local path is provenance only.

measurement_results.requirement: Verify the externally viewable SAGE demonstration visibly preserves PR21 lineage and explains the resulting architectural learning and constraint-aware interim-release decision.
measurement_results.assessment: The externally viewable SAGE experience demonstrated the required lineage and communicated the architectural learning and constraint-aware interim-release reasoning. Review identified human-factor and stakeholder-usefulness shortcomings in how that information was presented, but those findings do not negate the underlying demonstration.

human_factors_disposition.rationale: Presentation and stakeholder-usefulness findings are legitimate improvement evidence, but they are not evidence that the required lineage or architectural reasoning was absent from the experience.
human_factors_disposition.future_use: Retain the human-factor findings for subsequent SAGE experience and Human Participation Adapter improvement work without blocking Action-002 closeout.

historical_lifecycle_evidence.implemented_reason: Core Action-002 delivery is operationally demonstrated end to end. The exact immutable artifact was promoted without rebuild and the deployed digest passed zero-trust runtime validation. The Makefile receipt-transport and stale iteration-10 reconciliation defects are explicitly deferred as non-blocking technical debt under Architect authority.
historical_lifecycle_evidence.validated_reason: Validate Action-002 because the portable multi-architecture stage produced an immutable artifact, promotion consumed that exact artifact without rebuild, the exact promoted digest was deployed to the SAGE experience, and repository-owned zero-trust runtime validation passed. Tangential Makefile receipt-transport and stale iteration-10 reconciliation defects remain explicitly deferred as non-blocking technical debt.

architecture_convergence_finding.finding: SAGE closeout must distinguish durable attribution to an authoritative evidence source from local duplication or reconstruction of that source's evidence.
causal_evidence: The Action-002 closeout initially downgraded historically earned measurements because their original receipts were not locally reconstructable.

The objective-execution correction already demonstrated the analogous ownership rule for Git: Git owns detailed chronology while SAGE records semantic authority, invariants, milestones, and outcome evidence.
The same ownership principle applies to delegated evidence systems: lack of local duplication is not itself lack of authoritative proof.
architecture_convergence_finding.risk: Treating local reconstruction as proof durability creates duplicate authorities, unnecessary reconciliation work, and the same class of architectural error previously observed when SAGE duplicated Git's native chronology instead of attributing Git as authority.
architecture_convergence_finding.disposition: Do not build evidence-copying or workstation-state synchronization during Action-002 closeout. Preserve the authority-attribution principle as input to the required post-Action-002 architecture convergence review.
architecture_convergence_finding.reconsideration_trigger: Action-002 reaches terminal completion and the counterfactual architecture-convergence review begins, or a durable claim is found whose authoritative proof cannot be durably identified or queried.
architecture_convergence_finding.candidate_future_principle: Durable SAGE claims require durable attribution, not durable duplication. SAGE should preserve the authoritative system, immutable evidence identity, verification semantics, and retrieval/attestation reference. Machine-local state may cache evidence but should not become a second canonical authority when another system already owns the proof.
architecture_convergence_finding.explicit_non_solution: Do not synchronize ~/.local/state between machines and do not copy Git, GitHub Actions, artifact-registry, runtime-platform, monitoring, Vault, or other delegated authoritative evidence into SAGE merely to make a fresh clone locally reconstruct it.

decision_surface.measurement_recommendation: All Action-002 measurements are dispositioned: M1/M2 are historically validated delegated proof; M3 is not currently applicable with causal evidence retained; M4/M5 are demonstrated; M6 is demonstrated with separate human-factor findings.
decision_surface.closure_recommendation: Action-002 may proceed to terminal closeout; no measurement gap remains that requires Architect adjudication.

architectural_evidence_disposition.delegated_proof_rule: Durable attribution to authoritative proof is sufficient; local reconstruction or duplication is not required.
architectural_evidence_disposition.runtime_invalidation_rule: Runtime invalidation becomes actionable only after runtime applicability and runtime evidence are earned; non-actionable causal observations are still retained for future reconsideration.
architectural_evidence_disposition.human_factors_rule: A demonstrated capability is not reclassified as undemonstrated merely because review finds usability or stakeholder-presentation deficiencies. Those findings remain separate improvement evidence.
